declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The parties reached a settlement providing a $32 million class fund, automatic payments to identified class members, and up to $6 million in separately paid attorneys’ fees and expenses, subject to court approval. The agreement has no clear-sailing provision, and any fees not awarded will benefit the class rather than revert to Brightline. Counsel does not represent that fees were first discussed only after agreement on class relief. The parties’ confidential mediation communications are not recounted here.
